messages.subject: TSS calculation in Wallace code workflow
parts:
TSS and other metrics based on the confusion matrix are probably not appropriate to evaluate presence-background models. See https://doi.org/10.1111/jbi.13402, but other references also exist in the literature. Is there a particular reason you want to use TSS?

Jamie
